inventorygif.config.title: Inventory GIF Settings
inventorygif.config.animations.descripti: The tree follows image inheritance: Survival Inventory → game/mod → menu type → container title. Creative Inventory is independent. Menus appear after opening them in game. Put GIF and PNG files in inventorygif/animations/.
inventorygif.config.animations.empty: The inventorygif/animations/ folder is empty — drop a PNG there (plus an optional JSON with frame parameters).
inventorygif.config.animations.inherit.t: On — this node uses its parent's values (%s). Off — uses its own values below.
inventorygif.config.animations.scale.too: This node's scale. 0 — take from the parent, at the very top — the global one from General. Changing the value turns inheritance off.
inventorygif.config.animations.extras: Extra images (drawn next to the main one)
inventorygif.config.animations.image.sca: This image's own scale. 0 — use the global one from General.
inventorygif.config.animations.extra.dx: X Offset (from the main image's right edge)
X offset from the right edge of the main image. Applies when the slot has an animation selected.
Y offset relative to the main image. Applies when the slot has an animation selected.
inventorygif.config.animations.extra.sca: This image's own scale. 0 — use the node/global scale.
inventorygif.config.editor.description: Frame settings are written to JSON next to each animation on Save & Exit. Cancel discards changes.
inventorygif.config.xOffset.tooltip: Horizontal offset from the inventory GUI corner, in GUI pixels. The vanilla inventory is 176 px wide, so 178 places the animation just right of it.
inventorygif.config.yOffset.tooltip: Vertical offset from the inventory GUI corner, in GUI pixels.
inventorygif.config.scale.tooltip: Render scale of the animation. 1.0 = native 128x128 px, 0.75 = 96x96 px on screen.
inventorygif.config.frameDurationMs.tool: How long each animation frame is displayed, in milliseconds (100 ms = 10 fps).
inventorygif.config.frameCount.tooltip: Number of frames in the sprite sheet (frames are stacked vertically).
inventorygif.config.frameSize.tooltip: Width and height of a single animation frame in pixels (frames must be square).
inventorygif.config.texturePath.tooltip: Path to the sprite sheet PNG, relative to the game directory (or absolute). The file is re-read automatically when it changes on disk.
inventorygif.config.screenMode.tooltip: player = survival and creative inventory only; all = every container screen (chests, machines, modded GUIs).
inventorygif.config.dragToMove.tooltip: Allow moving the animation with the mouse: LMB — drag (the position is remembered per container screen; screens without their own position reuse the survival inventory one), RMB — reset the position of the current screen.
inventorygif.config.debugDrawPlaceholder: Draw a translucent placeholder square instead of the texture, to verify position and scale.
inventorygif.config.animations.locked.to: Blocks dragging and right-click reset for this node only. Inheriting screens are unaffected.
inventorygif.config.animations.source.in: Images inherited from %s. Editing an image creates local settings. Locking is configured separately.
inventorygif.config.animations.source.ow: Local images for this level. Changes are applied with Save & Exit.
